summary: LIS vendor added specimen_collection_tz and renamed observation_dt to observation_datetime without notice.
resolution: Updated target schema, backfilled 3 days, added the column to the ingestion-gate assertion. Raised a change-notice SLA with the vendor.

summary: Counterparty join skewed on a single high-volume corporate account holding 12% of all transactions.
resolution: Salted the join key with a 16-way split and enabled AQE skew join handling. Runtime fell from 68 minutes to 9.

summary: Service role lost s3:GetObject on the claims prefix after the quarterly entitlement review revoked an unattested grant.
resolution: Re-granted the specific prefix permission and registered the service role with a named owner so it is attested in future reviews.

summary: LIS nightly extract did not land; upstream job failed silently at the vendor.
resolution: Deferred rather than failed the run, extended sensor timeout to 8h, added an alert on the vendor SLA breach.

summary: Row count fell 32% because an upstream extract filtered on a stale effective-date window.
resolution: Fixed the extract predicate and re-ran. Publication stayed blocked throughout — the gate did its job.

summary: Genuine 3x volume growth after onboarding a new source; partition count unchanged since launch.
resolution: Increased executor memory and repartitioned from 200 to 800. Confirmed volume growth was real before provisioning.
